title: ROTIAH Peppermint Pest Repellent Pouches, 10 Pack

comparisons.notes: Official brand site; 10-pack option of the same peppermint rodent pouch (model PT-QSD) as the Woot listing; in stock

writeup: A 10-pack of ROTIAH peppermint pest repellent pouches (model PT-QSD) is $13.99 at Woot. ROTIAH's own site charges $24.29 for the same 10-pack, so this is about 42% less. Each pouch is rated to cover up to 145 square feet for roughly 30 days. Only a few are left, with a limit of 3 per customer.
